correctness.rationale: Define a_i=x_{2i}, b_i=x_{2i+1}; y_i=a_i+a_{i+1}+b_i with cyclic indices and counted multiplicity at m=1. Determinized subset-state transition matrix T has eigenvalues 0,2±sqrt2. A 0 or 3 label synchronizes closed paths; without them only the two even-length alternating 1/2 words have an extra singleton-state closed path. Therefore N_m=tr(T^m)−1−(−1)^m, not uncorrected trace. Independent enumeration of all 4^m binary sources for 1≤m≤9 recovered exact outputs and parity correction.
